patch_description: Revert to the parameter-economy champion (single shared parameter "theta" across all rotation gates, which previously achieved score 0.80 with n_params=8) instead of the current two-group parametrization (n_params=14, score 0.72). Additionally, per the dense-graph recommendation, replace the plain nearest-neighbor CZ ring with an alternating CNOT/CZ ring (still zero extra trainable parameters) to diversify the fixed entangling pattern, and keep an extra skip-2 CZ layer for richer connectivity. This should restore the higher parameter-efficiency score while potentially improving convergence speed and generalization through the more varied entangling structure.
